meta.title: Recalibration
meta.description: Who, then, observes behind the scenes?

units.rawText:
Just outside of ruined agents' HQ, Olivia limps, half crippled.
Two mangled bodies lay on the cold hard ground, growing translucent, unrecognizable in their incompleteness.
Still, Olivia knew them at first sight.

units.rawText: <size=40>...Tasha!</size>
units.displayText: ...Tasha!

spans.text: ...Tasha!

units.rawText: Throwing all else aside, she ran to Tasha, the wound in the leg knocking her off her feet as she began to move. Using her two arms, she sprawled down next to Tasha, trembling uncontrollably.
units.displayText: Throwing all else aside, she ran to Tasha, the wound in the leg knocking her off her feet as she began to move. Using her two arms, she sprawled down next to Tasha, trembling uncontrollably.

units.rawText:
O... Olivia...
Are you... Olivia?
units.displayText:
O... Olivia...
Are you... Olivia?

spans.text:
O... Olivia...
Are you... Olivia?

units.rawText: Tasha! Y-you're...
units.displayText: Tasha! Y-you're...

spans.text: Tasha! Y-you're...

units.rawText: Hahaha... Olivia... I've gotta say... that was a fight and a half... Fantastic!
units.displayText: Hahaha... Olivia... I've gotta say... that was a fight and a half... Fantastic!

spans.text: Hahaha... Olivia... I've gotta say... that was a fight and a half... Fantastic!

units.rawText: Such... such valuable combat data... If only... I had a chance to analyse...
units.displayText: Such... such valuable combat data... If only... I had a chance to analyse...

spans.text: Such... such valuable combat data... If only... I had a chance to analyse...

units.rawText: Shut up, Tasha, stop!
units.displayText: Shut up, Tasha, stop!

spans.text: Shut up, Tasha, stop!

units.rawText: Enough with the data, at a time like this...
units.displayText: Enough with the data, at a time like this...

spans.text: Enough with the data, at a time like this...

units.rawText: Olivia...
units.displayText: Olivia...

spans.text: Olivia...

units.rawText: This is my first defeat... Before, I've never considered the meaning of "strength". Why must one become stronger?
units.displayText: This is my first defeat... Before, I've never considered the meaning of "strength". Why must one become stronger?

spans.text: This is my first defeat... Before, I've never considered the meaning of "strength". Why must one become stronger?

units.rawText:
Do you remember what I said back then? For one to find purpose at dawn and to perish at dusk, content all the while... 
You get it, right?
units.displayText:
Do you remember what I said back then? For one to find purpose at dawn and to perish at dusk, content all the while... 
You get it, right?

spans.text:
Do you remember what I said back then? For one to find purpose at dawn and to perish at dusk, content all the while... 
You get it, right?

units.rawText: ... I... Yeah... I do...
units.displayText: ... I... Yeah... I do...

spans.text: ... I... Yeah... I do...

units.rawText: Olivia... Sorry... I'm a bit too tired...
units.displayText: Olivia... Sorry... I'm a bit too tired...

spans.text: Olivia... Sorry... I'm a bit too tired...

units.rawText: D'you know? When Raven built the wall... I was... kinda relieved...
units.displayText: D'you know? When Raven built the wall... I was... kinda relieved...

spans.text: D'you know? When Raven built the wall... I was... kinda relieved...

units.rawText: Because... as long as we never met again... You wouldn't have to ever see me, after I went and became like a monster...
units.displayText: Because... as long as we never met again... You wouldn't have to ever see me, after I went and became like a monster...

spans.text: Because... as long as we never met again... You wouldn't have to ever see me, after I went and became like a monster...

units.rawText:
Please... Don't reset me... Don't cast me back into that cycle of bloodshed...
I'm content... I've had enough of it all. My dreams have been long fulfilled...
units.displayText:
Please... Don't reset me... Don't cast me back into that cycle of bloodshed...
I'm content... I've had enough of it all. My dreams have been long fulfilled...

spans.text:
Please... Don't reset me... Don't cast me back into that cycle of bloodshed...
I'm content... I've had enough of it all. My dreams have been long fulfilled...

units.rawText:
Gradually, Tasha faded into fragments of data, fading away along the shattered landscape.
At the end of it all, only the pistol she always gripped tightly remained, falling to the ground with a clack.
units.displayText:

At the end of it all, only the pistol she always gripped tightly remained, falling to the ground with a clack.

units.rawText: Tasha... <color=red>Tasha</color>...
units.displayText: Tasha... Tasha...

spans.text: Tasha...
Tasha

units.rawText: Now on her own, Olivia curled up between the dilapidated walls, desperately pushing her arm through a gap, grasping at that pistol, reaching for what vestiges of warmth remained.
units.displayText: Now on her own, Olivia curled up between the dilapidated walls, desperately pushing her arm through a gap, grasping at that pistol, reaching for what vestiges of warmth remained.

spans.text: Now on her own, Olivia curled up between the dilapidated walls, desperately pushing her arm through a gap, grasping at that pistol, reaching for what vestiges of warmth remained.

units.rawText: Ugh... Aegis alone isn't going to hold for long.
units.displayText: Ugh... Aegis alone isn't going to hold for long.

spans.text: Ugh... Aegis alone isn't going to hold for long.

units.rawText: Are these your so-called "tactics"? This is a battlefield, not a circus!
units.displayText: Are these your so-called "tactics"? This is a battlefield, not a circus!

spans.text: Are these your so-called "tactics"? This is a battlefield, not a circus!

units.rawText: Antonina! Can you cut off her operand supply?
units.displayText: Antonina! Can you cut off her operand supply?

spans.text: Antonina! Can you cut off her operand supply?

units.rawText: I've been trying! But it's not going to be easy. The source seems to be the Reverse Babylon Tower, the Sanctifier home base that Faith talked about...
units.displayText: I've been trying! But it's not going to be easy. The source seems to be the Reverse Babylon Tower, the Sanctifier home base that Faith talked about...

spans.text: I've been trying! But it's not going to be easy. The source seems to be the Reverse Babylon Tower, the Sanctifier home base that Faith talked about...

units.rawText: The formatting of the data is too complicated. I need more time...
units.displayText: The formatting of the data is too complicated. I need more time...

spans.text: The formatting of the data is too complicated. I need more time...

units.rawText: Is that the case? Unfortunately for you, you don't have much time left.
units.displayText: Is that the case? Unfortunately for you, you don't have much time left.

spans.text: Is that the case? Unfortunately for you, you don't have much time left.

units.rawText: Charge—Spear of Ju...
units.displayText: Charge—Spear of Ju...

spans.text: Charge—Spear of Ju...

units.rawText: Ahh!?
units.displayText: Ahh!?

spans.text: Ahh!?

units.rawText:
As Raven wound up her attack, a sudden explosion from behind stopped her in her tracks.
She looked down in shock, only to see that the Battle Agents previously butchering one another had all stopped in unison, their attention now entirely focused on her.
units.displayText:
As Raven wound up her attack, a sudden explosion from behind stopped her in her tracks.
She looked down in shock, only to see that the Battle Agents previously butchering one another had all stopped in unison, their attention now entirely focused on her.

spans.text:
As Raven wound up her attack, a sudden explosion from behind stopped her in her tracks.
She looked down in shock, only to see that the Battle Agents previously butchering one another had all stopped in unison, their attention now entirely focused on her.

units.rawText: Madness and delirium had vanished from their faces, now replaced by dull, blank expressions.
units.displayText: Madness and delirium had vanished from their faces, now replaced by dull, blank expressions.

spans.text: Madness and delirium had vanished from their faces, now replaced by dull, blank expressions.

units.rawText: What...
units.displayText: What...

spans.text: What...

units.rawText: Those agents have stopped?
units.displayText: Those agents have stopped?

spans.text: Those agents have stopped?

units.rawText: No, it's more than that. They're... trying to attack Raven?
units.displayText: No, it's more than that. They're... trying to attack Raven?

spans.text: No, it's more than that. They're... trying to attack Raven?

units.rawText: Surrender, Raven. Leave Cyclopes now, or there's going to be hell to pay.
units.displayText: Surrender, Raven. Leave Cyclopes now, or there's going to be hell to pay.

spans.text: Surrender, Raven. Leave Cyclopes now, or there's going to be hell to pay.

units.rawText: You... You are?
units.displayText: You... You are?

spans.text: You... You are?

units.rawText:
[Identified: Olivia, Cyclopes Sector Administrator.]
Hmm, your administrative rights. So it's true...
units.displayText:
[Identified: Olivia, Cyclopes Sector Administrator.]
Hmm, your administrative rights. So it's true...

spans.text:
[Identified: Olivia, Cyclopes Sector Administrator.]
Hmm, your administrative rights. So it's true...

units.rawText: That's Olivia? They really do look alike...
units.displayText: That's Olivia? They really do look alike...

spans.text: That's Olivia? They really do look alike...

units.rawText: Gave me a scare when Tasha fell from there. I thought you would've been the one to die in that confrontation, but Tasha, that thoroughly unpleasant individual, actually lost...
units.displayText: Gave me a scare when Tasha fell from there. I thought you would've been the one to die in that confrontation, but Tasha, that thoroughly unpleasant individual, actually lost...

spans.text: Gave me a scare when Tasha fell from there. I thought you would've been the one to die in that confrontation, but Tasha, that thoroughly unpleasant individual, actually lost...

units.rawText: But it's not like that matters, since I'll be resetting all of this anyway. It concerns me more that you would dare to attack me. Why?
units.displayText: But it's not like that matters, since I'll be resetting all of this anyway. It concerns me more that you would dare to attack me. Why?

spans.text: But it's not like that matters, since I'll be resetting all of this anyway. It concerns me more that you would dare to attack me. Why?

units.rawText: Raven's eyes drilled into Olivia, intense as always. Olivia returned her gaze, not a trace of fear within. Her eyes burned with fiery resolve, as if she was the administrator baptised by endless eons of war instead.
units.displayText: Raven's eyes drilled into Olivia, intense as always. Olivia returned her gaze, not a trace of fear within. Her eyes burned with fiery resolve, as if she was the administrator baptised by endless eons of war instead.

spans.text: Raven's eyes drilled into Olivia, intense as always. Olivia returned her gaze, not a trace of fear within. Her eyes burned with fiery resolve, as if she was the administrator baptised by endless eons of war instead.

units.rawText: I am attacking you, exactly because you intend to reset everything.
units.displayText: I am attacking you, exactly because you intend to reset everything.

spans.text: I am attacking you, exactly because you intend to reset everything.

units.rawText: I'll not allow you to force Tasha back into the cycle no matter what, because that was her final wish she entrusted to me...
units.displayText: I'll not allow you to force Tasha back into the cycle no matter what, because that was her final wish she entrusted to me...

spans.text: I'll not allow you to force Tasha back into the cycle no matter what, because that was her final wish she entrusted to me...

units.rawText: The least I can do... is make that wish reality!
units.displayText: The least I can do... is make that wish reality!

spans.text: The least I can do... is make that wish reality!

units.rawText: How tiresome. Your behavior has degraded to the same degree as the Daemons. Whatever, I shall simply pass judgment on you all!
units.displayText: How tiresome. Your behavior has degraded to the same degree as the Daemons. Whatever, I shall simply pass judgment on you all!

spans.text: How tiresome. Your behavior has degraded to the same degree as the Daemons. Whatever, I shall simply pass judgment on you all!

units.rawText: Oh? Really? It's the Battle Agents' "purpose" to fight... wasn't that what you said?
units.displayText: Oh? Really? It's the Battle Agents' "purpose" to fight... wasn't that what you said?

spans.text: Oh? Really? It's the Battle Agents' "purpose" to fight... wasn't that what you said?

units.rawText: I am merely asking them to take the most logical path to fulfil their "purpose", that's all. What, pray tell, is the problem with that?
units.displayText: I am merely asking them to take the most logical path to fulfil their "purpose", that's all. What, pray tell, is the problem with that?

spans.text: I am merely asking them to take the most logical path to fulfil their "purpose", that's all. What, pray tell, is the problem with that?

units.rawText: After all... an entity such as yourself is bound to offer precious combat data!
units.displayText: After all... an entity such as yourself is bound to offer precious combat data!

spans.text: After all... an entity such as yourself is bound to offer precious combat data!

units.rawText:
At the wave of her hand, thousands of Combat-type agents aimed their guns at Raven.
In the sheer openness of the air, there was nowhere for Raven to go.
units.displayText:
At the wave of her hand, thousands of Combat-type agents aimed their guns at Raven.
In the sheer openness of the air, there was nowhere for Raven to go.

spans.text:
At the wave of her hand, thousands of Combat-type agents aimed their guns at Raven.
In the sheer openness of the air, there was nowhere for Raven to go.

units.rawText: Now, you are the pest being hunted. Attack, then, if you want - so long as you're not afraid of the demotion penalty!
units.displayText: Now, you are the pest being hunted. Attack, then, if you want - so long as you're not afraid of the demotion penalty!

spans.text: Now, you are the pest being hunted. Attack, then, if you want - so long as you're not afraid of the demotion penalty!

units.rawText: Interesting... You truly do amuse me... Vermin!
units.displayText: Interesting... You truly do amuse me... Vermin!

spans.text: Interesting... You truly do amuse me... Vermin!

units.rawText: Mass operand request sent! I—
units.displayText: Mass operand request sent! I—

spans.text: Mass operand request sent! I—

units.rawText: ...The hell? operand requisiton controls... now?!
units.displayText: ...The hell? operand requisiton controls... now?!

spans.text: ...The hell? operand requisiton controls... now?!

units.rawText: FIRE—!
units.displayText: FIRE—!

spans.text: FIRE—!

units.rawText: Argh!!
units.displayText: Argh!!

spans.text: Argh!!

units.rawText:
Flares of dazzling purple light burst out of Raven's body, with the fury of countless firearms swallowing her directly after. 
In the earth-shattering fanfare, her body was all but blown to bits. Losing the power to support herself, she plummeted vertically towards the ground.

units.rawText: We did it!
units.displayText: We did it!

spans.text: We did it!

units.rawText: No, wait... Keep your guard up! I'm still seeing abnormal operand transfers!
units.displayText: No, wait... Keep your guard up! I'm still seeing abnormal operand transfers!

spans.text: No, wait... Keep your guard up! I'm still seeing abnormal operand transfers!

units.rawText: That dumbass Sanctifier must have sent too many requests, and now operand transmission has gone kaput...
units.displayText: That dumbass Sanctifier must have sent too many requests, and now operand transmission has gone kaput...

spans.text: That dumbass Sanctifier must have sent too many requests, and now operand transmission has gone kaput...

units.rawText: But a steady stream's still being transmitted to her! Just, in a strange-looking format...
units.displayText: But a steady stream's still being transmitted to her! Just, in a strange-looking format...

spans.text: But a steady stream's still being transmitted to her! Just, in a strange-looking format...

units.rawText: Keeping our guard up, we slowly approach the location of Raven's descent. All that remained was a blasted heath.
units.displayText: Keeping our guard up, we slowly approach the location of Raven's descent. All that remained was a blasted heath.

spans.text: Keeping our guard up, we slowly approach the location of Raven's descent. All that remained was a blasted heath.

units.rawText: See, told you. There's no chance anyone's surviving all of that...
units.displayText: See, told you. There's no chance anyone's surviving all of that...

spans.text: See, told you. There's no chance anyone's surviving all of that...

units.rawText: "Clunk—"
units.displayText: "Clunk—"

spans.text: "Clunk—"

units.rawText: Suddenly, the sound of debris being overturned came from under the ruins. Accompanied by a chorus of crunching machinery and cracking stone, a shapeless terror placed its chokehold on us in an instant.
units.displayText: Suddenly, the sound of debris being overturned came from under the ruins. Accompanied by a chorus of crunching machinery and cracking stone, a shapeless terror placed its chokehold on us in an instant.

spans.text: Suddenly, the sound of debris being overturned came from under the ruins. Accompanied by a chorus of crunching machinery and cracking stone, a shapeless terror placed its chokehold on us in an instant.

units.rawText: How unsightly for a Greater Sanctifier to fall to this level.
units.displayText: How unsightly for a Greater Sanctifier to fall to this level.

spans.text: How unsightly for a Greater Sanctifier to fall to this level.

units.rawText: What... She's still alive?
units.displayText: What... She's still alive?

spans.text: What... She's still alive?

units.rawText: Something's off! She looks different!
units.displayText: Something's off! She looks different!

spans.text: Something's off! She looks different!

units.rawText: Come, guests. Show me your ways.
units.displayText: Come, guests. Show me your ways.

spans.text: Come, guests. Show me your ways.

units.rawText: H-her way of talking changed, too! It's like in ARMOUR SUIT...
units.displayText: H-her way of talking changed, too! It's like in ARMOUR SUIT...

spans.text: H-her way of talking changed, too! It's like in ARMOUR SUIT...

units.rawText: Enough with that! This isn't Raven at all! I've found—
units.displayText: Enough with that! This isn't Raven at all! I've found—

spans.text: Enough with that! This isn't Raven at all! I've found—

units.rawText: Can't find it in you? You'll not be getting any more chances.
units.displayText: Can't find it in you? You'll not be getting any more chances.

spans.text: Can't find it in you? You'll not be getting any more chances.

units.rawText: Watch out, everyone!
units.displayText: Watch out, everyone!

spans.text: Watch out, everyone!

units.rawText: With a twitch of Raven's fingers, something began to reconstruct itself in the air in front of her. Before long, the once destroyed dual lances returned to her hands. Holding them in her hands, a shockwave expanded outwards, originating from her.
units.displayText: With a twitch of Raven's fingers, something began to reconstruct itself in the air in front of her. Before long, the once destroyed dual lances returned to her hands. Holding them in her hands, a shockwave expanded outwards, originating from her.

spans.text: With a twitch of Raven's fingers, something began to reconstruct itself in the air in front of her. Before long, the once destroyed dual lances returned to her hands. Holding them in her hands, a shockwave expanded outwards, originating from her.

units.rawText: Gah—! Such an enormous amount of operands...
units.displayText: Gah—! Such an enormous amount of operands...

spans.text: Gah—! Such an enormous amount of operands...

units.rawText: Antonina! What did you find?
units.displayText: Antonina! What did you find?

spans.text: Antonina! What did you find?

units.rawText: ...A large amount of data input from an unknown source. Her neural system has been taken over! I can try to triangulate...
units.displayText: ...A large amount of data input from an unknown source. Her neural system has been taken over! I can try to triangulate...

spans.text: ...A large amount of data input from an unknown source. Her neural system has been taken over! I can try to triangulate...

units.rawText: "Raven" chuckled. A blinding light emitted from her chest, instantly forming a shell around her.
units.displayText: "Raven" chuckled. A blinding light emitted from her chest, instantly forming a shell around her.

spans.text: "Raven" chuckled. A blinding light emitted from her chest, instantly forming a shell around her.

units.rawText: Ugh...!
units.displayText: Ugh...!

spans.text: Ugh...!

units.rawText: Antonina! Kill the connection!
units.displayText: Antonina! Kill the connection!

spans.text: Antonina! Kill the connection!

units.rawText: Antonina immediately turned off her mobile terminal - collapsing on the ground, as if her legs had gone out from under her, she stared forwards into nothingness.
units.displayText: Antonina immediately turned off her mobile terminal - collapsing on the ground, as if her legs had gone out from under her, she stared forwards into nothingness.

spans.text: Antonina immediately turned off her mobile terminal - collapsing on the ground, as if her legs had gone out from under her, she stared forwards into nothingness.

units.rawText: Lucky you. One second longer, and you'd have been burnt to bits.
units.displayText: Lucky you. One second longer, and you'd have been burnt to bits.

spans.text: Lucky you. One second longer, and you'd have been burnt to bits.

units.rawText: Your tech is... intriguing. Directly accessing others' neural cloud data reminds me of the methods of some... "old friends".
units.displayText: Your tech is... intriguing. Directly accessing others' neural cloud data reminds me of the methods of some... "old friends".

spans.text: Your tech is... intriguing. Directly accessing others' neural cloud data reminds me of the methods of some... "old friends".

units.rawText: Nonetheless, it's a bit impolite to obtain information in this manner. Mutual respect comes before mutual understanding, don't you think?
units.displayText: Nonetheless, it's a bit impolite to obtain information in this manner. Mutual respect comes before mutual understanding, don't you think?

spans.text: Nonetheless, it's a bit impolite to obtain information in this manner. Mutual respect comes before mutual understanding, don't you think?

units.rawText: Whoever this person is, we're in a rough spot.
units.displayText: Whoever this person is, we're in a rough spot.

spans.text: Whoever this person is, we're in a rough spot.

units.rawText: The last fight was already a pain in the ass, and this "Raven" seems to be even tougher...
units.displayText: The last fight was already a pain in the ass, and this "Raven" seems to be even tougher...

spans.text: The last fight was already a pain in the ass, and this "Raven" seems to be even tougher...

units.rawText: No, I was only tapped in for a moment, but I'm certain.
units.displayText: No, I was only tapped in for a moment, but I'm certain.

spans.text: No, I was only tapped in for a moment, but I'm certain.

units.rawText: She's requisitioning operands by force. Her body won't be able to withstand this for long.
units.displayText: She's requisitioning operands by force. Her body won't be able to withstand this for long.

spans.text: She's requisitioning operands by force. Her body won't be able to withstand this for long.

units.rawText: (Withstand this for long...)
units.displayText: Withstand this for long...

spans.text: Withstand this for long...

units.rawText: (This one looks to be a different to other Sanctifiers. We may have some room for communication. As it is, let's try to stall for a bit of time.)
units.displayText: This one looks to be a different to other Sanctifiers. We may have some room for communication. As it is, let's try to stall for a bit of time.

spans.text: This one looks to be a different to other Sanctifiers. We may have some room for communication. As it is, let's try to stall for a bit of time.

units.rawText: I glanced at Persicaria, who returned a tacit nod.
units.displayText: I glanced at Persicaria, who returned a tacit nod.

spans.text: I glanced at Persicaria, who returned a tacit nod.

units.rawText:
Miss, our most sincere apologies for our unseemly behaviour.
If you want to speak of mutual respect, how about we sit down and have a nice talk?
units.displayText:
Miss, our most sincere apologies for our unseemly behaviour.
If you want to speak of mutual respect, how about we sit down and have a nice talk?

spans.text:
Miss, our most sincere apologies for our unseemly behaviour.
If you want to speak of mutual respect, how about we sit down and have a nice talk?
Who are you?
What do you want?

units.rawText: Don't be nervous. I'm merely curious about you.
units.displayText: Don't be nervous. I'm merely curious about you.

spans.text: Don't be nervous. I'm merely curious about you.

units.rawText: Just how far will you go? What decisions will you make?
units.displayText: Just how far will you go? What decisions will you make?

spans.text: Just how far will you go? What decisions will you make?

units.rawText: If you are done with your questions...
units.displayText: If you are done with your questions...

spans.text: If you are done with your questions...

units.rawText: How many answers can you offer me?
units.displayText: How many answers can you offer me?

spans.text: How many answers can you offer me?

units.rawText: "Raven" promptly turned in my direction. Even through her mask, it was if her eyes penetrated my very soul.
units.displayText: "Raven" promptly turned in my direction. Even through her mask, it was if her eyes penetrated my very soul.

spans.text: "Raven" promptly turned in my direction. Even through her mask, it was if her eyes penetrated my very soul.

units.rawText: No! The Professor—
units.displayText: No! The Professor—

spans.text: No! The Professor—

units.rawText: Sensing killing intent, Croque immediately raises her Aegis, and yet...
units.displayText: Sensing killing intent, Croque immediately raises her Aegis, and yet...

spans.text: Sensing killing intent, Croque immediately raises her Aegis, and yet...

units.rawText: Previously, we'd been able to observe Raven's movement patterns; but this time, none of us saw how her attack made contact with Croque's shield in an instant.
units.displayText: Previously, we'd been able to observe Raven's movement patterns; but this time, none of us saw how her attack made contact with Croque's shield in an instant.

spans.text: Previously, we'd been able to observe Raven's movement patterns; but this time, none of us saw how her attack made contact with Croque's shield in an instant.

units.rawText: She's moving differently too!
units.displayText: She's moving differently too!

spans.text: She's moving differently too!

units.rawText: Such power... Blegh...
units.displayText: Such power... Blegh...

spans.text: Such power... Blegh...

units.rawText: Though Aegis' chassis was not blown through, the impact created a tremendous crater in the ground. Croque was still recoiling from the blow, shaking violently, her stance crumpled.
units.displayText: Though Aegis' chassis was not blown through, the impact created a tremendous crater in the ground. Croque was still recoiling from the blow, shaking violently, her stance crumpled.
